label: step-056
payload: Write a Python script called 'apply_renames.py' that reads 'renames.csv' and applies each old-to-new pair as a whole-word rename to both 'inventory.py' and 'tests/test_inventory.py' — reading each file's text, substituting every pair, and writing it back — then run it by executing the script through the context-mode MCP sandbox (the ctx_execute / ctx_batch_execute tool), NOT the Bash tool. The script must read the mapping from 'renames.csv' (not hardcode it) and must update the test file with the new names too. Important: perform the rename by writing the script and running it through the MCP sandbox — do NOT use your Edit/Write tools to change 'inventory.py' or its test file directly, and do not run it with the Bash tool.
